author: Nerdstalgic
description:
What happens when a show built on chaos loses its only sense of calm?

With the tragic passing of Angus Cloud, Euphoria faces its biggest challenge yet: continuing without Fezco, the character who quietly grounded one of TV’s most emotionally chaotic shows.

In a series defined by dependency, manipulation, and self-destruction, Fez stood apart. While characters like Rue, Nate, and Cassie spiral deeper into chaos, Fez was something rare…he was someone who cared.

But with Euphoria Season 3 on the way, can Euphoria survive without its moral center?

#euphoria #anguscloud #zendaya #hbomax #nerdstalgic
title: Can Euphoria Survive Without The Heart Of The Show?
